data.title: Bitcoin Tops $60,000 as Risk Assets Rise in Holiday Trading
data.description: Bitcoin rose above the $60,000 mark on Thursday as risky assets tracked a rebound in tech equities, pushing crypto markets higher as they head into a period of thin holiday trading.
